timing: Weekly prior-close decisions, next-session-close resizing, monthly refits on completed weeks only. All policies use put-only during the common 52-week fitting warmup.
reward: Weekly sum of percent daily excess returns minus preference times sum of squared percent daily excess returns, minus 100 times the drawdown budget upon the first hard-budget crossing.
drawdown: Total account NAV drawdown from its continuing high-water mark. No reset between reporting periods. At 80% of budget, exclude new straddle allocations and queue existing straddles for next-close reduction. At budget crossing queue next-close liquidation and halt risk for the remaining history. Gaps can overshoot; report actual drawdown and stopping dates.
selection: For each budget and preference select training window by 2018-2021 realized utility. Fixed-action control selected using the same validation objective. Then replay 2022-2025 without replacing selections; matched discount-zero control uses the same selected window.
scope: Fractional exposures to the two retained funded strategy indices, preserving source costs and charging additional resizing and pooled-cash financing. Not a joint contract-admission backtest. The source strategies and these historical dates have already been researched.
